description: Linux package audit (RPM/DEB) for a given distro + version. Analyze Linux package vulnerabilities against the Vulners database.

include_candidates.description: Whether to include potential matches in results. If None, uses default behavior (typically false).

os.description: Linux distribution identifier (e.g., ubuntu, debian, centos, rhel, fedora). Use get_supported_os() to see available options.

package.description: Installed packages, each formatted EXACTLY as the target OS's own package manager lists them -- i.e. one line of the output produced by the command get_supported_os() returns for this OS. DEB-based distros (ubuntu, debian, astra, linuxmint, ...): space-separated 'name version arch', e.g. 'openssl 3.0.2-0ubuntu1.6 amd64'. RPM-based distros (rhel, centos, oracle, almalinux, rocky, fedora, amazon, suse, ...): 'name-version-release.arch', e.g. 'openssl-1.0.2k-25.el7_9.x86_64'. The bare hyphenated 'name-version' short form is NOT accepted -- the API rejects it as 'Invalid package'.

version.description: Distribution version/release (e.g., 22.04, 12, 8, 40). Must match a supported version for the specified OS.

name: audit_linux_packages
